description: A miniature circuit breaker protects electrical circuits from overcurrent and short circuits.
safety: Switch off the main supply before inspection.
maintenance: Check for overheating, loose terminals, discoloration and mechanical damage.
action: If repeated tripping occurs, inspect the connected circuit and load.

description: A contactor is an electrically controlled switch used to switch power circuits, commonly for motors.
safety: Isolate and lock out the power supply before servicing.
maintenance: Inspect contacts, terminals, coil condition and signs of overheating.
action: Check coil voltage and contact condition if the contactor fails to operate.

description: A relay is an electrically operated switch used for control and signal switching.
maintenance: Check terminals, coil operation and contact condition.
action: Verify the control voltage and relay contacts.

description: A circuit breaker automatically interrupts current when an abnormal electrical condition occurs.
maintenance: Inspect terminals, enclosure, mechanical operation and signs of overheating.
action: Investigate the cause of repeated trips before resetting.
